event_detail: Kettle on the counter right of the stove: 60 s into the episode the gripper is still hovering above it. It moves closer (60.8 s), backs off (62.4 s) and comes close again (64.0 s) without grasping, with the fingers nearly closed and not around the handle.
evidence: The right shoulder view shows the kettle standing on the counter in every frame, and only the pan is on the stove. The wrist view shows the kettle from directly above, changing size as the arm bobs up and down. The finger tips are together at the bottom of the image, with the kettle handle off to the side, not between them. Nothing has been lifted. It may still be about to grasp, so confidence is moderate.
